blocks.text: Make moving furniture the easiest part of your home move or remodel with Super Sliders 16 Piece Furniture Moving Kit. This 16 piece variety kit is a must-have for any home; it includes plastic sliders for carpeted surfaces and felt furniture sliders for hard wood, tile and linoleum surfaces. Plus, the kit comes with self-stick felt pads to protect hard surfaces from damage caused by the movement smaller pieces of furniture and décor. Both types of furniture movers protect your flooring from damage caused by moving or dragging furniture and everyday wear and tear. Just place them underneath the corner bases of your large and heavy furniture and with a simple push, you’ll quickly and effortlessly move your items across any hard or carpeted surface in your home! These furniture sliders provide proper weight distribution and a secure grip, making it easy to move furniture into just the right place. These round furniture movers are reusable, too. Super Sliders are the #1 best-selling and most trusted furniture mover on the market today - offering superior quality and long-lasting performance for all of your furniture moving and floor protection needs.

items: MOVE FURNITURE EASILY - Moving furniture can be the worst part of a move or remodel - but not with this resuable Super Sliders furniture movers kit. Simply place the movers under all your large, heavy items to quickly and easily move them across all surfaces - even carpet and hardwood

PERFECT FOR ALL FURNITURE - There is no piece of furniture too large or heavy for these furniture sliders. Use them on all your favorite items, including tables, sofas, beds, dressers, recliners, heavy appliances and more
TOTAL KIT - This kit of furniture movers includes plastic sliders for carpeted surfaces and felt sliders for hardwood, tile and linoleum surfaces in a variety of shapes and sizes
EASY TO USE - Simply place under each corner or edge of your piece of furniture and slide into its place

INCLUDES - Four 5" round hard sliders for carpet; Four 3 1/2" round hard sliders for carpet; Four 2 1/2" x 9" rectangular hard sliders for carpet; Four 3 1/2" round felt sliders for hard flooring; Four 5" square hard sliders for carpet; Thirty-two 1" round self-stick felt pads for hard flooring
